response.rationale: The defective flag is False in the order facts, so the defective-item exception (RET-020) does not apply despite the customer's description. This is an electronics item delivered 33 days ago (>15 days), so RET-003 applies and controls at priority 20, which dominates the standard-window rule RET-008 (priority 10). No final-sale, goodwill, or fraud-hold conditions are met. Item is ineligible for return.
